licenseStatement: The upstream README describes the assets as free and without copyright. Its meta.json labels the repository NASA Open Source Agreement Version 1.3. No per-texture copyright or observation metadata is supplied. Preserve both statements and link to NASA media usage guidance.

textures.notes: Surface texture published by NASA for 3D visualization. It shows surface terrain/albedo, not a contemporary photograph of the disk. The archive provides no acquisition date or color calibration for this file.

Cloud-band texture published by NASA for 3D visualization, including a Great Red Spot feature. Cloud positions and appearance change over time. The archive provides no acquisition date or color calibration for this file.
Cloud-band texture published by NASA for 3D visualization. It does not contain a ring map. The archive provides no acquisition date or color calibration for this file.

Strongly processed blue texture published by NASA for 3D visualization. The archive does not establish natural color, the observing mission/date, or measured detail at every longitude. Do not describe it as a calibrated true-color photograph.

Orange surface-relief visualization in the NASA archive, consistent with a processed radar surface map. It is not an optical photograph of Venus cloud tops: opaque clouds prevent seeing this surface directly in visible light. The archive provides no mission/date or calibration metadata, so do not attach a specific mission attribution.
